_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback (retrieved 2026-09-03) prints this stop_details shape verbatim; the field types are confirmed against RefusalStopDetails in the shipped .d.ts of @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.123.0 (messages.d.ts L2184-2213).
_note: A refusal is an ordinary HTTP 200, not an error. Under the server-side-fallback beta, stop_details can also carry recommended_model and fallback_credit_token; both are absent here because this fixture models a request that did not set `fallbacks`.

stop_details.explanation: The request could enable cyber harm.
